commands: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== git ==='; git status --short; git rev-parse HEAD
set -euo pipefail; CLI=/Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli; echo '=== cli ==='; test -x "$CLI"; "$CLI" --version; echo '=== drc help ==='; "$CLI" pcb drc --help | sed -n '1,120p'

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== libraries ==='; for d in /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport/symbols /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/SharedSupport/footprints; do echo "--- $d"; test -d "$d" && { echo present; find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 | head -12; } || echo missing; done
set -euo pipefail; echo '=== python api candidates ==='; find /Applications/KiCad -type f \( -name 'python3' -o -name 'pcbnew.py' -o -name '_pcbnew*.so' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== user kicad dirs ==='; for d in "$HOME/Documents/KiCad" "$HOME/Library/Preferences/kicad" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/kicad"; do if test -e "$d"; then echo "--- $d"; find "$d" -maxdepth 2 -type d | sed -n '1,80p'; fi; done; echo '=== final status ==='; git status --short
